title: NetworkPresenceListResult
description: network.presence-list-result@1: the public presence of the people one person may see, from GET /api/v1/presence?subjects=… (the person's own token) or GET /internal/presence?for=…&subjects=… (a first-party service with network.presence.read). Only people the asker follows or has a DM with, and themselves, are answered; a stranger and an invisible person are left out (the caller reads them as offline), never as an error. At most 100 subjects per call.

presence.description: The visible people, in no particular order.
